$comment: KPI registry: the single authority for what every metric, dimension and business rule means. The gold SQL (registry/generated/*.sql), the API's metric queries and the AI tool descriptions are all generated from this file. Change a definition here, bump `version`, then run `node scripts/generate-registry-sql.js`. Never edit a definition anywhere else.

premiumPriceThreshold.description: A product is 'premium' when its current price is at least this amount, otherwise 'standard'.

product_reviews.description: Product-grain gold table. Base measures are stored in additive form so any rollup is exact.
product_reviews.from: SampleData p LEFT JOIN SampleData r ON r.productId = p.productId AND r.docType = 'review'

priceBand.label: Price band
priceBand.build: CASE WHEN p.currentPrice >= {rule:premiumPriceThreshold} THEN 'premium' ELSE 'standard' END

sumStars.label: Total stars
sumStars.description: Sum of review stars. A building block for avgStars; rarely meaningful on its own.

reviewedProducts.label: Reviewed products
reviewedProducts.description: Number of products that have at least one review.

avgStars.label: Average rating
avgStars.description: Average review stars on a 1-5 scale, weighted by review: total stars divided by total reviews. Never an average of product averages.

lastReviewDate.description: Date of the product's most recent review.
